recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-39476 unless a future tracker reopens bdl-7 semantics beyond the already-applied missing-versionId fallback.
issue_request: FHIR-39476 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked FHIR-I to revise Bundle invariant bdl-7. The issue explained that selecting fullUrl&resource.meta.versionId made resources without meta.versionId collapse to an empty value, effectively requiring version ids when duplicate fullUrls appeared, contrary to the intended rule.
initial_application: The change was applied before this reconciliation by git commit 4a5d9b44614a286ad703b525a850b8464f4978b1, which changed source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml from fullUrl&resource.meta.versionId to fullUrl&iif(resource.meta.versionId.exists(), resource.meta.versionId, ''). The commit is contained in the v5.0.0 tag and the current source still has that expression.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Bundle as an active resource and assigns it to infrastructure, so the inspected StructureDefinition is in current build scope. FHIR-I WGM minutes corroborate the Jira vote as Persuasive 13-0-3. The November 2022 Zulip IG creation thread shows the validation problem that led Grahame to file FHIR-39476. Jira neighborhood search found older bdl-7 history issues FHIR-15649 and FHIR-18284 but no later final decision that changes this correction.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active Bundle StructureDefinition already implements the requested bdl-7 expression, and no duplicate AutoFHIR trailer commit existed on the combined branch, so an empty no-change audit commit was published.
